title: Violin Concerto in E major: I. Allegro
video_use_ideas: Three bold hammer-stroke chords then sunny drive: an announcement opener.
legal_notes: Composition PD worldwide (J. S. Bach d.1750). Mutopia piece 29 ('Concerto in E major for violin and strings', for Violin and String Orchestra: Two Violins, Viola, 'Cello); licence shown as Public Domain on the piece page, in the Mutopia RDF and in the .ly header (placed in the public domain by typesetter David Chan). Edition source: Bach Gesellschaft zu Leipzig, 1874. Preview is an own FluidSynth (FluidR3_GM) render of the Mutopia MIDI, not a human performance; no recording in this row.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
